mails.subject: Invoice 40817 overdue - payment failed
mails.body:
Hello,

We attempted to process the monthly payment for your workspace services account but the transaction was declined by the issuing bank.

Invoice number: 40817
Amount due: 2,340.00 DKK
Original due date: 2026-09-10
Status: Payment failed (code 51)

To avoid interruption of service and a late fee of 250.00 DKK, please review the invoice and update your payment details using the secure link below within 48 hours.

View invoice and update payment method:
https://secure-portal.norvik-ledger.example/invoices/40817/pay

If you have already settled this invoice, please disregard this notice. A copy of the invoice is available in your account area once you sign in.

Please note that accounts with two failed attempts are passed to our collections partner.

Kind regards,
Accounts Receivable
Norvik Ledger Services
This mailbox is not monitored.
mails.justification: Phishing: a fake overdue invoice from a company the space has no account with, pushing a payment link. The sender has no relationship with the space and the message was never requested.

mails.subject: Re: great meeting you at the community night
mails.body:
Hi again,

Just following up on this, I know things get busy after events.

> It was so good to connect with you last week, we should really explore something together.

I wanted to say that the energy at your community night was something special, and honestly it reminded me why we started Hollowbay Collective in the first place. We work with spaces and communities across Northern Europe, and I have a feeling there is a natural fit between what you are building and what we do.

I do not want to be pushy, so I will keep it simple. I think a quick call could open up some interesting possibilities for both sides, from co-branded moments to shared audiences and beyond. We are very flexible and always open to ideas.

Are you free for 15 minutes sometime next week? I can work around your schedule completely.

Also, please say hi to the team from me, everyone was so lovely.

Warmest wishes,
Priya
Partnerships Lead, Hollowbay Collective
hollowbay-collective.example

mails.subject: Confidential: unclaimed estate, beneficiary needed
mails.body:
Dear Friend,

I am a legal representative handling the estate of a late client, Mr. Harald Voss, who died without known family in 2024. The estate holds the sum of 4,800,000 EUR in a dormant account. After a long search I have been unable to locate any relative.

I am writing to propose that your organisation act as beneficiary. The funds would be released to you with my assistance, and we would share the proceeds: 60 percent to you, 40 percent to me for legal costs and taxes. All documents will be prepared by my office and the process is completely legal and safe.

To proceed, I only need the following:
- Your full legal name
- Your address and phone number
- A copy of an identification document

Please treat this matter as strictly confidential and do not discuss it with others until the transfer is finished. Time is limited because the bank will transfer the funds to the state treasury after the end of the year.

I look forward to your quick reply.

Respectfully,
Dr. Emeka Adaobi
Adaobi Chambers
mails.justification: Advance-fee inheritance scam asking for identity documents from a stranger. The sender has no relationship with the space and the message was never requested.
